note: Per-fit calibration timings on d1_decontaminated_sb (train n=36,287). Motivates (a) tuning max_features for tree/boosting families and (b) running the XGBoost search on the GPU. Feeds the dissertation's accuracy-vs-computational-cost analysis.
decisions: XGBoost is pathologically slow on 100k-dim TF-IDF on CPU (605 s/fit); RF is fine (7.9 s); linear models trivial.
XGBoost search runs on GPU (device=cuda): 106x speedup measured at 20k features.
Tree/boosting families (dt, rf, xgb, lgbm) tune TF-IDF max_features in {10k, 20k, 50k}; linear (lr, nb, svc) keep 100k.
XGB/LGBM drop n_estimators from the search: fixed 800 with early_stopping_rounds=50 on validation AUC.
Determinism: search may use GPU, but every finalist retrain and the single test evaluation run on CPU (device=cpu, seed 42).
